Topic: What to Do About High Plagiarism Scores
Body of the Announcement: Any plagiarism score above 50% is a cause for action. You do not need to rewrite your code simply to obtain a lower score. However, you do need to research the plagiarism report, identify the areas of overlap, and comment on what you found. Include those comments with your homework submission when you turn it in.
